title: Checkpoint: the discount chain
prompt:
Implement the chain: `Customer.pay(int amount)` returns the amount. `Member extends Customer`: pay returns `super.pay()` minus 5%. `Gold extends Member`: pay returns `super.pay()` minus another 5% (so 90% of the original). Use integer arithmetic exactly as written: Member pays `amount - amount / 20`; Gold pays `amount - amount / 10`.

Implement all three classes and the given `pay` signatures.

tests.name: discount chain
tests.hint: Each level computes its own discount on the ORIGINAL amount (no super needed here) — or chains via super; both must yield 95/90.
